name: Runner Extras - Report Metadata virtual tables
brief: Proves the Report Metadata (2000000139) and Report Data Items (2000000203) system virtual tables answer truthfully.
description: Both metatables are parsed out of the System package so the tables exist, but nothing provides rows for them — so Report Metadata.Get(<any id>) returns false and Report Data Items is always empty, including for reports the runner compiled itself moments earlier. Real BC answers truthfully. AL that discovers a report's shape through these tables (which is the documented, supported way to do it) therefore takes its not-found branch unconditionally: Pageworks' report-discovery entity set lists nothing, and its DeriveSourceTable returns 0 for every report. The negative cases matter as much as the positive ones — a provider that answered true to everything, or that ignored the report id, would satisfy the positive cases alone.
